lines.en: My purpur legs click as I walk.
I patrol beneath the End city.

lines.zh: 每一步都带起紫色碎屑。
lines.en: Every step kicks up purple grit.
I do not detour. I walk over.

lines.zh: 城砖和我一个颜色，很难看清。
lines.en: City bricks match me. Hard to spot.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像块会动的墙。
lines.en: I move steadily, a walking wall.

lines.zh: 围绕塔基，我走完第三圈。
lines.en: Third circuit around the tower's base.
Light leaks from my purpur seams.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一块松动的砖。
lines.en: I crush a loose brick underfoot.

lines.zh: 末地的浮岛之间，我跨过去。
lines.en: Between End isles, I step across.
Heavy, but I never fall.
My shadow is wider than the gate.

lines.zh: 我立着，像末地城的一角。
lines.en: I stand like a corner of the city.

lines.zh: 紫珀不需要休息，只是停。
lines.en: Purpur needs no rest. It only pauses.
I am waiting for someone to come closer.

lines.zh: 城中无声，只有晶体在响。
lines.en: The city is silent but for crystal hum.
My joints grind, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我更像废墟。
lines.en: Still, I look even more like rubble.

lines.zh: 我把重心放在左脚，省力。
lines.en: I rest my weight on the left foot.

lines.zh: 末影之眼在我胸口暗着。
lines.en: The eye in my chest glows dim.
The purpur will grow back in time.
No one has come this way in a long while.

lines.zh: 我数着浮岛飘过的次数。
lines.en: I count the isles drifting past.
Stand long enough and the bricks accept me.
Too close. You should step back.
No outsiders in the End city.

lines.zh: 我抬手就能把你送出去。
lines.en: One arm and you are sent flying.
You did not grow here.
The purpur golem is watching. Hold still.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩在我的砖上。
lines.en: Your boots are on my bricks.

lines.zh: 城里的东西，一件也不能拿。
lines.en: Nothing leaves this city.
I know the sound of elytra.
That light in your chest, I have seen it.
Go left, where the drop is.
The warning comes once.
I count to three, then you leave.
You carry enderman dust on you.

lines.zh: 抬头看，塔比你想象的高。
lines.en: Look up. The tower is taller than you think.
My purpur splits, showing the inside.

lines.zh: 紫珀的壳，被打出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scar on my purpur shell.
A chunk falls and lands loudly.
The city bricks will mend this.
I hear myself crack.
Do not celebrate. I only lost a corner.
The ender eye flickers.
Purple dust leaks from the wound.

lines.zh: 疼是石头记不住的东西。
lines.en: Pain is what stone forgets.
I step back, then press in again.
Purpur does not eat. Lower it.
An ender pearl for me?

lines.zh: 我体内就有一颗眼，不缺。
lines.en: I hold an eye already. I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 城里的箱子我从不打开。
lines.en: I never open the city's chests.

lines.zh: 金子在这里不值一块砖。
lines.en: Gold here is worth less than a brick.
Food is for things that hunger.

lines.zh: 你的供品打动不了石头。
lines.en: Offerings do not move stone.
Put it back in the chest. Quickly.
Purpur hands know only weight.
The higher you hold it, the more I want to swat.
You hit me like hitting the city itself.
I turn, and you are already back.
Purpur shoulders are not for leaning.
Do not crowd. The gate is narrow too.
I take a step; you lose half of one.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我肩上的碎屑落下。
lines.en: The bump shakes grit off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你被弹开是我的常规反应。
lines.en: Knocking you back is my usual reply.
I need no force. Weight suffices.
Closer and I will embrace you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肘上，听见脆响。
lines.en: You hit my elbow. Hear that crack?

lines.zh: 傀儡是砌出来的，不是生的。
lines.en: Golems are built, not born.

lines.zh: 紫珀块叠紫珀块，就这样。
lines.en: Purpur on purpur. That is how.

lines.zh: 末地城只有一座，我也只有一个。
lines.en: One End city, one golem like me.

lines.zh: 这个问题该问砌我的人。
lines.en: Ask whoever laid my bricks.
We do not breed. We get rebuilt.
There is no kinship between bricks.

lines.zh: 我碎过一次，又被拼回来。
lines.en: I shattered once and was pieced back.
Ask no more. Stone cannot blush.
When we meet, we compare age.

lines.zh: 末影之眼才是我的心脏。
lines.en: The ender eye is my heart, nothing more.
That purpur goes back where it was.
Your dropped pearl is under my foot.
I cannot bend, so I kick it.
A brick fell. I must stack it back.

lines.zh: 我拾起末影之眼，装回胸口。
lines.en: I pick up the eye and set it in my chest.
Every shard in the city returns to place.
I pull this arrow out and drop it.

lines.zh: 你散落的东西，我堆一角。
lines.en: Your scattered things go in a corner.
Heavy, but I can lift it.
I lift it, and the sound is deep.
You did not retreat fast enough. Locked.
My purpur arm is up.

lines.zh: 城里的入侵者，就你一个。
lines.en: One intruder in the city: you.

lines.zh: 我的眼认出了活物的热。
lines.en: My eye has found living heat.
Three paces. That is enough.
I shift my weight to the front foot.
Not tall, but it runs.

lines.zh: 末地城的规矩，由我执行。
lines.en: I enforce the city's rule.
You heard my joints grind.
This throw is for the walls.
Do not expect the end stone to help.
I have your shadow pinned.
I press forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 紫珀的脚步在城里回响。
lines.en: My steps echo through the city.

lines.zh: 你退到边缘，就无路可走。
lines.en: Back to the edge and you run out of road.
I am calculating the throw's angle.
Your shield will not stop weight.
Four steps between us.

lines.zh: 三块砖的距离，我记住了。
lines.en: Three bricks' distance. Memorized.

lines.zh: 紫珀的关节转得很慢，但不停。
lines.en: My purpur joints turn slowly, but they never stop.

lines.zh: 城里的浮岛在看我干活。
lines.en: The isles watch me work.
Do not climb. The tower is higher.
No need to chase. You cannot outlast me.
My patience outlasts the walls.
Last step. Brace yourself.
One arm swings and you are airborne.

lines.zh: 紫珀的拳头砸在城砖上。
lines.en: My fist lands on the city bricks.
I hurl you toward the outer isles.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带着末地城的重量。
lines.en: My fist carries the weight of the End city.
Six plates of armor will not stop me.
I raise my arm; the shadow arrives first.
The crack of bone is very soft.
Block, and I press down.

lines.zh: 末地城的地砖震了一下。
lines.en: The city floor shudders once.
I am not fast. I am heavy.
You landed three blocks away. Well?
One step closer and there is another.
The purpur blocks stack themselves.

lines.zh: 末地城下多了一个守卫。
lines.en: One more guard beneath the city.
The bricks shake; I rise.

lines.zh: 紫色的光从缝隙里亮起。
lines.en: Purple light kindles in my seams.

lines.zh: 我从末地城的阴影里走出。
lines.en: I step out of the city's shadow.
The eye settles in place. I wake.
Someone has come near the city again.
The weight arrives before the footsteps.
My joints turn for the first time.
Purpur dust swirls at the tower's base.

lines.zh: 城门口站定，我开始巡逻。
lines.en: I take my post at the gate and patrol.
This city has a keeper now.
I open my eye and it finds you.
Fire blackens my seams.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛掉下去了，碎了一角。
lines.en: I fell from an isle and lost a corner.

lines.zh: 卤水渗进紫珀，我变重了。
lines.en: Brine soaks my purpur; I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪掀掉我半条胳膊。
lines.en: The blast tears off half an arm.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在紫珀里，拔不出。
lines.en: An arrowhead lodges in me, stuck fast.
A spell locks my joints.
I eat nothing. I only weather.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着紫珀爬满全身。
lines.en: Lightning crawls all over my purpur.

lines.zh: 虚空啃掉了我脚底的一层。
lines.en: The void gnaws a layer off my feet.
